text: Not Pixel FAQs – Telegraph Not Pixel FAQs Not Pixel January 07, 2025 Not Pixel FAQs Not Pixel When will the $PX token be listed? Soon, soon. Will there be a pre-market or $PX vouchers? No pre-mine, presale, pre-market in any form 🛑 70% of $PX will go directly into the hands of miners and the community , while only 10% will be distributed via Earn Launchpool . What will the price of $PX be at the time of listing? The price is determined by supply and demand. In fact, only Not Pixel players will dictate the price on the listing. $PX is owned by the most active and honest miners. Not Pixel probably had the strictest screening of bots and low-active players in the history of Telegram Mini Apps. Think about it: 80% of the issue is in the hands of real players who have made a serious effort. Thus, $PX already has value – equal to the efforts made. Btw, the $PX share of the Not Pixel team will be locked for the listing period. The supply is only in the hands of the community. How ambitious is Not Pixel? Let’s find out. Locked $PX for the team 🔥 As relatively large holders of the issue, we are limiting our own influence on the $PX supply. The team will focus on what really matters: the long-term development of the Not Pixel ecosystem, which will bring new ways for people to collectively express themselves. At the TGE, 100% of the Not Pixel team tokens will be locked . Unlocking the team’s share of $PX will start from the second month after the TGE: 10% for 10 months. Slow and steady, no rush. Which CEX or DEX will $PX be listed on? 🤷🏻‍♀️ There’s some boring bureaucratic stuff holding us back from sharing this info right now. Hang tight, we’re closer than ever. Is it worth selling $PX at listing? We totally respect your personal choice. If you decide to pass on some or all of your $PX to new holders, no worries. It’s been an epic journey with you, and we’re hyped to cross paths again down the road! 🔳 How will the coins of bots and those who have not mined 100 $PX be distributed? Time to turn those pixels into pure fire! 🤖 78% of bot tokens will be given to active players for various achievements. The remaining 22% of bot tokens are getting wiped out for good. Game balances under 100 $PX? They’re getting wiped. Clean-slate vibes. Will there be additional bonuses for achievements? Yep, bot tokens are getting redistributed based on your game hustle: referrals, leagues, secret words, early activity, and more. Coming soon for everyone to check out 🥇 Not Pixel tokenomics will not be affected . What perks and rewards are available for beta testers? 👩‍🚀 The beta test achievement grants everyone 20 $PX, along with additional rewards for those who participated in the bug bounty program. How many players will get the «Megadrop»? 0.18% of the total number of holders. Will there be a separate award for Pixanos from Not Pixel? The community is already quite appreciative of Pixanos’ exploits. Keep shining, $PX fam! ✊🏻 When will the NFT generator become available? Beta testing is already in full swing 🥔🔥 What is «Golden Pixel»? Golden Pixel represents rewards that will become available after the listing. Stay tuned for updates on what they will be 🔮 Are there plans to hold a quarterly Telegram Battle? 🏆 Not Pixel has already outnumbered all popular pixel battles for both the number of players and length of play, including Reddit, VK, and other events. We will definitely continue to do so. Around 30 million people got in on the Telegram Battle, and we’re aiming to blow that number up several times. It’s totally realistic with the massive Telegram audience and all the pixel battle communities on other platforms. We expect more attention for such events, and we are already preparing. Our near-term plans include increasing the canvas size by 100 times . It’s looking like Telegram’s gonna be the hub for the loudest, most epic pixel battles in the world 🌐⚔️ What are the use cases of $PX? 📦 The main role of $PX is to interact with the Not Pixel ecosystem to gain access to certain features and special privileges in the game. We’re now building a deflationary economy in which $PX will become the ultimate and indispensable in-game tool . What’s next? 🔭 Multi-phase expansion: new game modes (payments, auctions, betting, collabs, and more), rewards for holders, next-gen Pixel Battles that would become more strategic-like games, expansion into other pixels, and NFT communities. Our first version of Not Pixel involved the use of cryptocurrency (and we even implemented that in the MVP). Now, after the completion of the mining and TGE phase, we will return to innovation: launching new game modes and implementing a decentralized pixel canvas based on smart contracts on TON blockchain. Our roadmap will have more details.
